pois.label: L4 vs L5 选边裁决
pois.detail: 日火 L4(火星前方 60°)与 L5(后方 60°)在通信几何上严格对称:40 年扫描里,无论停在哪一点,直连黑障期间中继两跳全部畅通,残余全断天数都是 0——几何不投票。裁决落在两条次级判据上。其一,碎片环境:已知火星特洛伊小行星 L5 有 14 颗(Eureka 5261 及其成员构成一个成因家族,意味着往小尺寸延伸的碎片尾巴),L4 只有 2 颗;把全城唯一的黑障生命线泊进行星唯一已知的特洛伊家族里,是没必要的暴露。其二,L5 的真实优势要诚实记账:太阳自转把活动区先转向 L5、4.4 天后才面向火星,L5 能预报共转结构(CIR)——选 L4 就放弃这份预警。但 CME 侧视测速两点等价(见日冕仪卡),CIR 亦可由自转外推部分补偿。通信任务选干净的停车位:L4。
pois.detail_en: Sun-Mars L4 (60 deg ahead) and L5 (60 deg behind) are strictly symmetric in comm geometry: over a 40-year sweep, from either point both relay hops stay clear throughout every direct-link blackout - residual total-outage days are 0 either way. Geometry casts no vote. The adjudication falls to two secondary criteria. First, debris environment: Mars's known Trojans number 14 at L5 (5261 Eureka and its members form a genetic family, implying a debris tail extending to small sizes) versus 2 at L4; parking the city's only blackout lifeline inside the planet's only known Trojan family is unnecessary exposure. Second, L5's genuine advantage goes on the books honestly: solar rotation turns active regions toward L5 first and toward Mars 4.4 days later, so L5 can forecast corotating structures (CIRs) - choosing L4 forfeits that warning. But CME side-view speed measurement is equivalent from either point (see the coronagraph card), and CIR timing is partly recoverable by rotation extrapolation. A comm-critical mission takes the clean parking spot: L4.

pois.physics: L4/L5 的存在:圆型限制性三体问题中,与两主天体成等边三角形的两点上,引力合力恰好提供随系统共转所需的向心力;当 27μ(1−μ)<1(日火系 μ=3.2×10⁻⁷,判据值 8.7×10⁻⁶)时线性稳定——科氏力把偏离的航天器卷回蝌蚪形回路,不是引力井是引力舞步。CIR 预警的 4.4 天 = 60°÷(太阳恒星自转 14.2°/天 − 火星公转 0.5°/天,即相对火星的会合角速率 13.7°/天)。
pois.physics_en: Why L4/L5 exist: in the circular restricted three-body problem, at the two points forming equilateral triangles with the primaries, net gravity supplies exactly the centripetal force to corotate with the system; linear stability holds when 27 mu(1-mu) < 1 (Sun-Mars mu = 3.2e-7, criterion value 8.7e-6). The Coriolis force sweeps a displaced spacecraft into tadpole loops - not a gravity well but a gravity dance. The 4.4-day CIR preview = 60 deg / (14.2 deg/day SIDEREAL solar rotation - 0.5 deg/day Mars orbital motion = 13.7 deg/day Mars-synodic rate).
sim: s03(开普勒真偏心双行星 + 60° 旋转 L4/L5,40 年 0.25 d 步长):19 次合日,L4 案与 L5 案残余全断天数均为 0.0——对称性被逐日验证而非假设
s05 已知答案闸:L4 处旋转系加速度 3.6×10⁻¹⁶(平衡点成立);27μ 判据 8.7×10⁻⁶ ≪ 1(稳定)
sim_en: s03 (Kepler two-planet with true eccentricities + L4/L5 by 60-deg rotation, 40 yr at 0.25 d steps): 19 conjunctions; residual total-outage days are 0.0 for BOTH the L4 and L5 cases - symmetry verified day-by-day, not assumed
s05 known-answer gates: rotating-frame acceleration at L4 is 3.6e-16 (equilibrium holds); the 27-mu criterion is 8.7e-6 << 1 (stable)

pois.label: 黑障压缩账(对地链路)
pois.detail: Ø3 m X/Ka 双频对地天线——整个任务浓缩在这一面碗里。直连黑障的真实账:40 年 19 次合日,SEP<2° 全断 12.0–18.8 天/次(均值 14.0,闸门对上城册的 14.4)。中继为什么能把它压到零:L4 恒离火星 60°,火星→L4 跳永不贴日;而地球看 L4 的合日与看火星的合日错开 60° 相位 = 130 天,两个黑障在时间轴上永不见面。L4 自己也有每会合周期 18.8–28.2 天(均值 21.5,40 年 18 次)的对地合日——但那时火星直连畅通,没人需要它。压缩比的诚实写法:全断 14 天 → 全断 0 天;代价是那两周里全城对地只剩本星的窄带信道(1.4 Mbps 级,见火星侧卡),科学数据流照常积压。
pois.detail_en: The 3 m dual X/Ka Earth dish - the whole mission condensed into one aperture. The honest direct-blackout ledger: 19 conjunctions over 40 years, total outage at SEP<2 deg of 12.0-18.8 days each (mean 14.0; gate matches the city ledger's 14.4). Why the relay compresses it to zero: L4 stands a constant 60 deg from Mars, so the Mars-to-L4 hop never grazes the Sun; and Earth's conjunction with L4 is offset from its conjunction with Mars by 60 deg of synodic phase = 130 days - the two blackouts never meet on the timeline. L4 has its own Earth conjunction each cycle, 18.8-28.2 d (mean 21.5, 18 of them over 40 yr) - but Mars's direct link is wide open then, and nobody needs the relay. The honest form of the compression ratio: 14 days of total outage -> 0 days; the price is that for those two weeks the city's entire Earth service is this bird's narrowband channel (~1.4 Mbps class, see the Mars-leg card) and the science stream keeps queueing.

The direction favours this conclusion but must be stated in full: real blackouts are shorter and conjunctions far from a node may not black out at all, so the 14.0 d mean is an UPPER BOUND and the relay value concentrates in near-node conjunctions; both relay hops gain clearance too, so the 0-residual result is strengthened rather than threatened

pois.physics: 黑障的物理不是遮挡是日冕:SEP<2° 时视线穿过太阳附近稠密湍动的日冕等离子体,射频闪烁把相干解调撕碎,光链路则直接被 2° 内的太阳辐照淹没(com-optical-01 的合日光断 33 天与此同源)——所以 L4 同时是射频与光两条链的共同备份。黑障时长 ∝ 阈值角/(相对角速率):火星近日点附近合日时火星角速率快(账里 18.8 天那几次)……方向相反:角速率差小则黑障长,12–18.8 天的散布全部来自两行星真偏心率。
pois.physics_en: The physics of blackout is not occultation but corona: at SEP<2 deg the line of sight threads the dense turbulent coronal plasma near the Sun - RF scintillation shreds coherent demodulation, and the optical link is drowned outright by solar irradiance within 2 deg (com-optical-01's 33-day optical conjunction outage shares this origin) - which is why L4 backs up BOTH the RF and the optical chains at once. Outage length scales as threshold angle / relative angular rate; the 12-to-18.8-day spread in the ledger comes entirely from the two planets' true eccentricities modulating that rate.

pois.label: 火星侧链路与时延实话
pois.detail: Ø2.5 m 金网天线回望火星——1.5 AU 外,行星只是一颗亮星,这面碗对准的是 Jezero 的 12 m 地面站(com-station-01,Ka EIRP 98 dBW)。火星侧 Ka 跳 2.5–3.6 Mbps,瓶颈在对地腿,端到端回程 ~1.4 Mbps(HFSS 真馈源 + PO 实解背书,s08/s14);前向(地球→城)84 kbps,足够指令、软件上注与新闻文本。备份路径走静止环中继星的 2.5 m 对地碟改指 L4:只有 ~0.3 kbps——真应急底线。时延卡必须写实:合日期直连光程 22 分钟,经 L4 两跳 33 分钟——中继比直连慢 11 分钟。这颗星不卖速度,卖的是「链路存在」本身;14 天里它是两颗行星之间唯一还亮着的线。
pois.detail_en: The 2.5 m gold-mesh dish looks back at Mars - from 1.5 AU the planet is just a bright star, and this bowl points at Jezero's 12 m ground station (com-station-01, Ka EIRP 98 dBW). The Mars-side Ka hop runs 2.5-3.6 Mbps; the bottleneck is the Earth leg, so the end-to-end return is ~1.4 Mbps (HFSS-feed PO-backed, s08/s14). Forward (Earth to city) is 84 kbps - enough for commands, software uplinks and the news in text. The backup path uses the areo relay's 2.5 m Earth dish repointed at L4: ~0.3 kbps - a true last-ditch floor. The latency card must tell the truth: at conjunction the direct light path is 22 minutes, the two-hop relay path 33 minutes - the relay is 11 minutes SLOWER than the link it replaces. This bird does not sell speed; it sells the existence of a link. For those 14 days it is the only lit line between two planets.

pois.physics: 「窄带应急信道,不是宽带镜像」的定量版:回程 1.4 Mbps 是光学干线(1.5 AU 处 22.6 Mbps)的 6.1%、地面站吞吐(600 Mbps)的 0.25%。它保的是遥测、指令、语音文本与压缩后的关键数据,科学数据流等黑障结束再排空——这与 com-relay 数据流账里「日凌积压 70 天排空」是同一本运营账的两页。时延变长的几何必然:任何绕开太阳的折线都比穿过太阳邻域的直线长,三角不等式没有例外。
pois.physics_en: The quantitative form of 'narrowband lifeline, not broadband mirror': the 1.4 Mbps return is 6.1% of the optical trunk (22.6 Mbps at 1.5 AU) and 0.25% of the ground station's 600 Mbps throughput. It preserves telemetry, command, voice/text and compressed critical data; the science stream waits out the blackout and drains afterward - the same operational ledger as com-relay's 70-day post-conjunction backlog drain, one page apart. The longer latency is geometric necessity: any dogleg around the Sun is longer than the straight line through its neighborhood; the triangle inequality grants no exceptions.

pois.label: 转移与站位保持
pois.detail: 开放桁架舱里的两只氙罐就是转移账本身:467 kg 氙罐装 = 打靶积分解 4.43 km/s(s12:逃逸螺旋 104 天 1.22 km/s + K=1 相位轨道 694 天 3.21 km/s,全程 798 天,需氙 421 kg)+ 10% 装载裕度(霍尔推力器,Isp 1800 s;化学 SK 推进剂随行入账)。到站之后账反转成全城最便宜的轨道:L4 是稳定平衡点,不站坑也不漂走。但停车有走廊:半长轴偏差 |Δa| 必须小于 21 万 km,否则蝌蚪回路撑破界线退化成马蹄轨道——绕到太阳对面再回来,一圈上百年(仿真里 0.005 AU 的粗放注入正是这样逃逸的,这个负结果定义了注入精度需求)。走廊内 6.8 万 km 偏差对应 ±0.27 AU 的天平动幅度,60 年不散。站位保持 ≤1 m/s/yr:太阳光压全抵消上界才 1.9 m/s/yr,而稳定点其实连全抵消都不需要。
pois.detail_en: The two xenon tanks in the open truss bay ARE the transfer ledger: 467 kg of xenon loaded = the integrated targeted solution of 4.43 km/s (s12: 104-day escape spiral at 1.22 km/s + 694-day K=1 phasing orbit at 3.21 km/s, 798 days total, needing 421 kg) plus a 10% loading margin (Hall thrusters, Isp 1800 s; chemical SK propellant booked as riding along). Once on station the ledger inverts into the city's cheapest orbit: L4 is a STABLE equilibrium - no slot to hold, no drifting away. But the parking has a corridor: the semi-major-axis error |da| must stay under 210,000 km, or the tadpole loop bursts its separatrix and degenerates into a horseshoe orbit - swinging around the far side of the Sun and back, a century per lap (a sloppy 0.005 AU insertion in the sim escaped exactly this way; that negative result defines the insertion-accuracy requirement). Inside the corridor, a 68,000 km offset librates at +/-0.27 AU for 60 years without dispersing. Stationkeeping <=1 m/s/yr: even the full-cancellation bound on solar radiation pressure is only 1.9 m/s/yr, and a stable point does not require full cancellation at all.

pois.physics: 蝌蚪与马蹄的分界是能量账:共转系里沿轨道方向的有效势在 L4/L5 处开浅碗、在 L3 处留鞍口,Δa 给航天器的相对能量超过鞍口高度(∝√μ)就会翻过去绕成马蹄——走廊宽度 √(8μ/3)·a 因此正比于 √μ,日火系的 μ 小,走廊窄到必须写进注入规格。为什么中继星在静止轨道年缴 33 m/s 而这里 ≤1:那边是不稳定平衡附近的主动占位,这边是稳定平衡的顺势而居——位保费从来不是轨道的属性,是「你想待的地方」与「引力想让你待的地方」的差价。
pois.physics_en: The tadpole/horseshoe boundary is an energy ledger: in the corotating frame the effective potential along the orbit dips into shallow bowls at L4/L5 with a saddle gap at L3; give the spacecraft more relative energy (via da) than the saddle height (~sqrt(mu)) and it spills over into a horseshoe. The corridor width sqrt(8mu/3)a is therefore proportional to sqrt(mu) - and the Sun-Mars mu is small enough that the corridor must be written into the insertion spec. Why the areo relay pays 33 m/s/yr while this bird pays <=1: that one actively holds ground near an unstable equilibrium; this one settles where gravity already wants it. Stationkeeping cost was never a property of orbits - it is the price difference between where you insist on being and where gravity insists you be.
sim: s05 CR3BP(平面圆型限制三体,μ=3.227×10⁻⁷):60 年积分,走廊内注入天平动有界 0.27 AU;首跑 0.005 AU 注入马蹄逃逸至 1.5 AU——负结果入账为注入精度需求
s12 转移轨迹积分(挖掘轮):逃逸螺旋 + bang-coast-bang 相位段三参数打靶,闸 3 道全绿(功-能闭合 8×10⁻¹⁰、滑行段轨道能量守恒 1×10⁻¹⁰、打靶闭合 60.16°/Δa 1×10⁻⁶/e 0.0013);留痕:绝热恒等式闸首版误设——有限推力逃逸本就低于 v_circ 极限(F/10 单调逼近 1.32→1.45 验证),闸改为功-能恒等式而非放宽
s05 闸:L4 点加速度 3.6×10⁻¹⁶(平衡)、27μ=8.7×10⁻⁶<1(稳定);地球 L4/L5 任务提案 m/s 级/年同带对标
sim_en: s05 CR3BP (planar circular restricted three-body, mu = 3.227e-7): 60-yr integration; in-corridor insertion librates bounded at 0.27 AU; the first run's 0.005 AU insertion escaped horseshoe-wise to 1.5 AU - the negative result booked as the insertion-accuracy requirement

s12 transfer-trajectory integration (deep-dive round): escape spiral + bang-coast-bang phasing, 3-parameter targeting, 3 gates green (work-energy closure 8e-10, coast orbit-energy conservation 1e-10, targeting 60.16 deg / da 1e-6 / e 0.0013); on record: the first gate demanded the adiabatic dV=v_circ identity at design thrust - wrongly, since ANY finite thrust escapes below the limit (F/10 monotone approach 1.32 to 1.45 verified); the gate was replaced by the work-energy identity, not loosened
s05 gates: acceleration at L4 3.6e-16 (equilibrium), 27mu = 8.7e-6 < 1 (stable); anchored in-decade against Earth-L4/L5 mission proposals' ~m/s per year

pois.label: 日冕仪:黑障季的太阳哨
pois.detail: +Y 甲板上的小口径日冕仪,遮光筒尖上挑着一枚掩星盘。它守的是一个几何死角:合日期太阳恰好站在地球与火星之间——地球的太阳望远镜看不见朝向火星的那半球,火星的仪器又在黑障里说不出话。而 L4 从 60° 侧方看去,日火连线附近的日冕正好呈侧视:CME 朝火星出发的速度与方向,在这个视角上是横越视场的平面运动,测得最准(STEREO 侧视测速的同一套几何)。黑障 14 天里,它是全城唯一的太阳预警源,警报正好从本星的应急信道回城。诚实脚注:共转结构(CIR)的 4.4 天预报属于 L5,选 L4 时已在选边卡里挂账放弃。
pois.detail_en: A small coronagraph on the +Y deck, an occulter disk perched on its baffle spike. It guards a geometric blind spot: at conjunction the Sun stands exactly between Earth and Mars - Earth's solar telescopes cannot see the hemisphere facing Mars, and Mars's own instruments are mute inside the blackout. From 60 deg aside, L4 sees the corona near the Sun-Mars line edge-on: a CME departing toward Mars crosses this field of view as plane-of-sky motion, which is precisely where its speed and direction measure best (the same geometry as STEREO's side-view ranging). For the 14 blackout days it is the city's only solar-warning source - and the warning rides home on this very bird's emergency channel. Honest footnote: the 4.4-day CIR forecast belongs to L5; choosing L4 booked that loss on the adjudication card.

specs.载荷: 小口径日冕仪 + 掩星盘(25 kg 级)
specs.视角: 距日火连线 60° 侧视 · CME 平面天运动测速
specs.守的窗口: 合日黑障 12–19 天/会合周期
specs.预警链: L4 观测 → 本星应急信道 → 城内辐射警报(sci-pan/SEP 模式同链)
specs.诚实脚注: CIR 4.4 天预报是 L5 的,已放弃

specs_en.Viewing geometry: 60 deg off the Sun-Mars line; CME plane-of-sky ranging
specs_en.Window guarded: the 12-19 day conjunction blackout each cycle
specs_en.Warning chain: L4 observation -> this bird's emergency channel -> city radiation alerts (same chain as sci-pan's SEP mode)
specs_en.Honest footnote: the 4.4-day CIR preview belongs to L5 - forfeited

pois.physics: 日冕仪的物理是把 10⁻⁶ 太阳亮度的日冕从太阳圆面旁抠出来:掩星盘在光学入口外先造一次人工日食,再靠筒内多级光阑吃掉衍射环。侧视测 CME 的几何优势:视向运动只能靠多普勒或到达时间反推,平面天运动直接在连续两帧上量位移——朝火星走的 CME 对 L4 恰是后者。对地球方向传播的空间天气,地球自己的 L1 卫星看得更早;这台仪器不与任何人重复,它只补「火星在黑障里」这一个洞。
pois.physics_en: A coronagraph's physics is prying the corona - a millionth of the solar disk's brightness - out from beside it: the occulter stages an artificial eclipse before the optics, and internal stop chains eat the diffraction rings. The side-view advantage for CMEs: line-of-sight motion must be inferred from Doppler or arrival times, but plane-of-sky motion is measured directly as displacement between frames - and a Mars-bound CME is exactly plane-of-sky to L4. Earth-bound space weather is seen earlier by Earth's own L1 fleet; this instrument duplicates no one - it plugs the single hole labeled 'Mars is inside the blackout'.
sim: s03 几何:合日期 L4 对日火连线的侧视角恒 60°(等边三角形);黑障窗口 12.0–18.8 天逐次列账
预警时效账:CME 1.5 AU 走 2–4 天,侧视测速在出发后数小时可给到达估计——警报经 84 kbps 前向信道足够(kB 级报文)
sim_en: s03 geometry: L4's side view of the Sun-Mars line is a constant 60 deg (equilateral); blackout windows 12.0-18.8 d booked per conjunction

Warning-latency ledger: a CME covers 1.5 AU in 2-4 days; side-view ranging yields an arrival estimate within hours of departure - and the alert is a kB-class message, trivial for the 84 kbps forward channel

pois.label: 平台共构与深空改装账
pois.detail: 同一个中继星平台,65.7% 逐行同件——但这次共构最漂亮的一笔是被物理送来的:太阳翼按 SEP 转移在 1.52 AU 处出 4 kW 定尺寸,算出来正好还是那副 36 m² 翼。深空改装四件套:3 m 双频 HGA、100 W 行波管链(含冷备)、SEP 模块、日冕仪——四个新备件族,是 26 个月备件账里本星与静止环家族真正的分账线。反向的红利在热与电:L4 永无星蚀(不绕任何行星),5 kWh 电池缩到安全模式级 15 kg,热环境恒定如钟——航天器最怕的循环疲劳在这里不存在。湿重 1895 kg,其中 467 kg 是氙:质量账的 1/4 花在「到那儿去」。
pois.detail_en: The same relay platform, 65.7% identical line-by-line - and this time the prettiest entry is a gift from physics: the solar wing, sized by the SEP transit's 4 kW demand at 1.52 AU, comes out to exactly the same 36 m2 wing. The deep-space kit is four items: the 3 m dual-band HGA, the 100 W TWTA chain (with cold spare), the SEP module, and the coronagraph - four new spares families, the true dividing line between this bird and the areo family in the 26-month spares ledger. The reverse dividend is thermal and electrical: L4 never sees an eclipse (it orbits no planet), the 5 kWh battery shrinks to a 15 kg safe-mode unit, and the thermal environment is clock-steady - the cyclic fatigue spacecraft fear most simply does not exist here. Wet mass 1895 kg, of which 467 kg is xenon: a quarter of the mass budget spent on 'getting there'.

specs.新备件族: HGA / 100 W TWTA / SEP / 日冕仪(4 族)
specs.功率: 翼由 SEP 转移定尺寸(4 kW @1.52 AU)= 同款 36 m² · 通信期负载 1.25 kW 富余
specs.星蚀: 永无 · 电池 33→15 kg · 热环境恒定
specs.26 个月备件结论: 平台件并入静止环共池,4 族深空件单列

specs_en.Mass: 1409 kg dry (20% margin incl.), 1895 kg wet (467 kg xenon)
specs_en.New spares families: HGA / 100 W TWTA / SEP / coronagraph (4 families)
specs_en.Power: wing sized by SEP transit (4 kW @1.52 AU) = the same 36 m2 wing; 1.25 kW comm-phase load, power-rich
specs_en.26-month spares verdict: platform lines join the areo pool; 4 deep-space families stand alone

pois.physics: 「同平台改型还是新平台」的判据不是外形是环境:辐射(1.52 AU 深空 SPE+GCR ≈ 火星静止轨道同量级,无俘获带的红利两边通用)、热(更稳)、力学(发射载荷同族)——平台三大定尺寸环境全部落在先例包线内,所以是改型。改不动的地方全是任务本身:天线口径由 2.2 AU 对地距离定,SEP 由 60° 相位差定,日冕仪由黑障几何定。平台适配环境,载荷适配任务——这条分界本身就是共构率 65.7% 的物理内容。
pois.physics_en: The 'variant or new platform' criterion is environment, not silhouette: radiation (deep-space SPE+GCR at 1.52 AU lands in the same decade as areostationary Mars - the no-trapped-belt dividend applies to both), thermal (steadier), structural (same launch-load family) - all three platform-sizing environments fall inside the precedent envelope, hence a variant. Everything that could NOT stay common is the mission itself: aperture set by the 2.2 AU Earth range, SEP set by the 60-deg phase offset, coronagraph set by blackout geometry. Platform fits environment, payload fits mission - that dividing line IS the physical content of the 65.7%.
sim: s06(逐行缩放,记账闸:中继星重建 1265.3/1361.9 kg 后再动):共构率 = 与先例完全同值行的质量占比;氙 467 kg 由火箭方程(5 km/s,Isp 1800,化学 SK 推进剂随行)闭合
功率交叉账:SEP 4 kW @1.52 AU 需求 → 36 m² 翼(与中继星星蚀热容账定出的同款);通信期 1.25 kW 负载富余 3×
s13 辐射器 COMSOL FEM(挖掘轮,承先例 radiator_thermal 管线):通信工况 TWTA 底板 −12°C、SEP 转移工况 PPU 底板 +16°C(能量闭合 0.999998/1.000016,等温解析 ±0.3 K 括住)——交付几何的 2.43 m² OSR 双工况全裕度,无需改动
sim_en: s06 (line-by-line scaling; bookkeeping gate: the relay rebuilds to 1265.3/1361.9 kg before edits): commonality = mass share of lines identical to the precedent; the 467 kg xenon closes via the rocket equation (5 km/s, Isp 1800, chemical SK propellant riding along)
Power cross-ledger: the SEP demand of 4 kW at 1.52 AU sizes the wing to 36 m2 - the same wing the relay's eclipse heat-capacity ledger produced; the 1.25 kW comm-phase load leaves 3x headroom

s13 radiator COMSOL FEM (deep-dive round, precedent radiator_thermal pipeline): comm-phase TWTA baseplate -12 C, SEP-transit PPU baseplate +16 C (energy closure 0.999998/1.000016, isothermal analytic brackets the FEM mean to 0.3 K) - the delivered 2.43 m2 OSR pair carries both duties with margin, no geometry change
